changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE transport_routes ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, route_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, agency_name VARCHAR(255), route_short VARCHAR(50), route_long VARCHAR(255), route_type SMALLINT NOT NULL, route_color VARCHAR(10), geom GEOMETRY(LineString, 4326), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW() );

changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE transport_stops ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, stop_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, stop_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, latitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, longitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, geom GEOMETRY(Point, 4326), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW() );

changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE transport_trips ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, trip_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, route_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL REFERENCES transport_routes(route_id), service_days VARCHAR(50), trip_headsign VARCHAR(255), direction SMALLINT );

changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE transport_stop_times ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, trip_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL REFERENCES transport_trips(trip_id), stop_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL REFERENCES transport_stops(stop_id), arrival_time INTERVAL NOT NULL, departure_time INTERVAL NOT NULL, stop_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL );

changeSet.author: rostyslav
